The body becomes more efficient in this state as it converts fat into energy. It is proven that with this type of diet you will achieve very good results in a short time. The comments of our users also confirm it... many have already managed to lose the weight they wanted.

Who can use this application?
This app can be used by anyone since its use is very simple. You only have to configure the number of days and a personalized plan will be generated for each day. If you don't like the suggested food you can change it to your liking.

In this application we can find the following tools:
- Weight diary for each day (to have a good control)
- Personal diary to save our thoughts
- Shopping lists with which we can write down everything we need
- Personalized notifications with mealtime reminders

Download this app now and start whenever you want your new challenge with a ketogenic diet!
